item.title: The Missing Variable in AI Publishing Policies: Detection Bias
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The Missing Variable in AI Publishing Policies: Detection Bias Ganjavi and colleagues provide a valuable map of how publishers and journals have responded to generative AI through author instructions and disclosure requirements. item.title: Re: Tackling the global hypertension crisis - unmet needs
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The recent analysis by Etyang et al., regarding the global hypertension crisis (BMJ 2026;392:s367) rightly emphasises the need for scaled interventions and the cost of insufficient implementation. However, the global strategy remains incomplete without addressing the silent physiological foundation of cardiovascular health: sleep. item.title: Broad, ill-defined terms are unhelpful when promoting rehabilitation for ME/CFS
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, The authors promote ‘bespoke programmes designed to increase activity’ and ‘tailored approaches’. Since the 2021 NICE guidelines for ME/CFS recommended against ‘fixed, incremental increases in physical activity’ as a treatment, many patients have been offered physical rehabilitation framed as ‘bespoke’ or ‘tailored’. item.title: Re: Partha Kar: Expanding roles of healthcare staff—where are the safety checks?
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, Dr Kar writes an excellent piece on concerns that many resident doctors share about the expansion of non-doctor roles in the NHS. There is clearly a role for associated healthcare practitioners in certain fields.
